svg.title: Primary languages across 50 public repositories
svg.desc: Snapshot captured 6 September 2026. Primary repository languages: TypeScript 21, Python 16, JavaScript 3, Swift 3, and Other 4. Other contains C#, Dart, Go and Rust. Three repositories are unclassified. Counts describe repositories, not proficiency.
